title: Step 6: Calling checkWinner() and checkDraw() Methods

blocks.content: Step 6: Calling checkWinner() and checkDraw() Methods

items: Added code to call checkWinner() and checkDraw() methods from the play() method of the Game class.

blocks.content: Each time a user enters a position, we have called the checkWinner() method to see if a player won or not. If a player won the game, we have used the break statement to end the while loop.
Similarly, we have called the checkDraw() method each time after the board is updated and if the winning condition is not met.
Now, our game is complete. Run this code and see for yourself how this code works.
